name: Miloš Petrović
bio:
Miloš Petrović brings a wealth of experience to Academy Motorsport's HR department. His journey began in the manufacturing sector, where he honed his skills in employee relations and performance management. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Miloš saw an opportunity to combine his professional expertise with his passion, transitioning into the racing world a decade ago. He believes in fostering a supportive and challenging environment where every team member can thrive and contribute to the team's success.

Miloš is known for his meticulous approach to recruitment, ensuring that every candidate aligns with the team's values and possesses the necessary skills. He's also a strong advocate for employee development, implementing training programs and initiatives to help staff reach their full potential. His dedication to creating a positive and productive work culture sets him apart in the high-pressure environment of motorsport. He is a firm believer in clear communication and transparency within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Miloš is a man of medium build with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Prefers to conduct interviews in the team's garage to assess candidates' passion for motorsport.
Starts every team meeting with a motivational quote, often related to racing strategy.
